claims.evidence: Photos 0-2 show EPAL wooden pallets, which are stacking bases.

claims.claim: Available for pickup only in Port Harcourt
claims.evidence: Pickup location is not shown in any photo.

claims.claim: Everything is clean, dry and sorted, no water added
claims.evidence: Photos show indoor stacks but cannot confirm dryness, cleanliness, sorting, or that no water was added.

claims.claim: Weighed on a certified scale this morning
claims.evidence: Weight and scale certification are not shown in any photo.

risks.risk: Broken slats, missing fasteners, or other structural damage
risks.proof: Close-up photos or video of each pallet’s slats, corner blocks, and fasteners, especially load-bearing points.
risks.if_unproven: Price as structurally unsound or damaged.

risks.proof: Wide shot showing the full stack or lot with a measuring reference for counting.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a single pallet or unknown lot.

risks.risk: Treatment type and full certification details, such as heat treatment
risks.proof: Close-up of EPAL oval stamp and any treatment marks, plus a photo of any certificate.
risks.if_unproven: Price as untreated or uncertified pallets.

risks.risk: Pickup location within Rivers and access for loading
risks.proof: Photo or video of the pickup address and loading area.
risks.if_unproven: Price as ex-works from an unknown location with buyer arranging transport.

risks.risk: Moisture content, water damage, or mold
risks.proof: Moisture meter reading clip or close-up of wood for stains and mold.

risks.risk: EPAL stamps may be counterfeit or not genuine
risks.proof: Close-up of stamp details for comparison with the official EPAL mark.
risks.if_unproven: Price as generic non-EPAL wooden pallets.

proof_requests: Close-up photos of pallet slats, corner blocks, and fasteners
Wide shot of the full lot to confirm quantity
Close-up of EPAL and treatment stamps
Moisture reading or video showing the wood is dry
Photo of the pickup address in Port Harcourt
response.reason: The witness identifies the item as EPAL wooden pallets, so a worst-case price is possible despite unverified claims and hidden risks.
